name: The Eye of Paleth
summary: Fitzsimmons asks you to recover The Eye of Paleth from the sunken Intrepid. Then carry the cursed gem to Glorin Steelbrow in Menethil Harbor, where the dwarven priest seeks a way to purge its blight.

sections.title: A Blighted Relic
sections.body: Beneath Baradin Bay, the Intrepid's locked strongbox holds a blackened orb. The Eye of Paleth pulses under the water, warped from sacred light into a source of suffering. Its corruption binds it to the restless spirits and doom that claimed the sailors of the Third Fleet.

sections.title: Seeking the Priesthood
sections.body: Glorin Steelbrow examines the relic in Menethil Harbor. The dwarven priest of the Holy Light is stunned that such a sacred device belonged to the Third Fleet. He recognizes its unnatural taint and begins preparing rites to undo its dark influence.

faq.q: What is the Eye of Paleth?
faq.answer: The Eye of Paleth is an ancient and powerful sacred gem, usually bound to holy energies. Aboard the sunken Third Fleet vessel Intrepid, it has become twisted and cursed, radiating dark magic.

aliases: where do i find the eye
faq.answer: You recover the Eye from a locked strongbox in the flooded wreck of the Intrepid, just off the Wetlands coast.

faq.q: Why does Glorin Steelbrow care about the artifact?
faq.answer: Glorin Steelbrow is a dwarven priest stationed in Menethil Harbor. His knowledge of the Holy Light lets him recognize ancient relics and begin rites to break sinister curses.

faq.q: How does Fitzsimmons know about the Eye?
faq.answer: Fitzsimmons survived the tragedy of the Third Fleet, and it still haunts him. Taking refuge in Menethil's tavern, he knew a dark relic lay hidden in the wreckage and tormented his fallen crewmates.

The Eye's corruption is tied to the supernatural deaths and restless undead haunting the Third Fleet's wrecked ships. It absorbed dark energies during or after the catastrophe that sent the fleet to the ocean floor.

faq.q: What happens after giving the Eye to Glorin?
aliases: what to do with the eye
faq.answer: Glorin examines the cursed gem and sees it cannot remain blighted. He directs you to cleanse the relic of its corrupting influence.

angles.text: As a priest, you have reason to care when a sacred artifact like The Eye of Paleth is defiled. Its blight touches your faith in the Holy Light.
As a dwarf, you share a dedication to reclaiming lost relics off Khaz Modan's shores. Ironforge clergy like Glorin Steelbrow can aid you.
As an Alliance member, you know the Third Fleet's destruction left Menethil Harbor vulnerable. Recovering its remnants can bring closure to lost comrades.
